annotations.title: Read a Slack direct message thread

description: Read the direct messages between the Hermoso app and ONE workspace member, newest first: what they answered after send_slack_dm, or what they wrote to the app. Leave member out to list EVERY direct message people sent the app, one line per person with whether it was answered (this needs the app’s im:read permission; an install made before 2026-11-16 is told to add Hermoso again). It reads only the app’s own DMs, never anyone else’s conversations. No DM yet is an empty list, said in words. Needs the Hermoso app in the Slack workspace with its direct-message permissions: a workspace that added the app before 2026-11-15 adds it again once under Connectors > Slack (the tool says so). Free.

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in — id or exact name from list_brands (a shared workspace: its profile id). Needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to; applies to THIS CALL ONLY. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

member.description: member id (U…), @name or full name; leave out to list every DM

slackWorkspace.description: which workspace (id or name) when there are several
